Document type: adjuster_file. Page 1 of 2.

<page>
Harbor Point Mutual Auto Insurance
Bodily Injury Unit
Claim Notes
Claim number:
C-1474
Claimant:
Jennifer Johnson
Adjuster:
Jerry Hanson
October 31, 2023
First notice of loss received from the policyholder's vehicle occupant reporting a low-speed head-on collision with
another vehicle. Claim opened and assigned for review.
November 8, 2023
Confirmed that the driver is named on the policy and that coverage was in force at the time of the reported loss.
Nothing in the file suggests the damage predates the coverage start.
January 27, 2024
Spoke with the claimant by phone. The account of the collision was clear and matched the initial report in its
sequence and details.
February 2, 2024
Reviewed the photographs submitted with the claim. They confirm several key details of the scene and the position of
both vehicles, though no independent witnesses have come forward.
February 3, 2024
Police report obtained. It confirms the claimant was in the vehicle at the time of the collision, and the responding
officer's notes are consistent with the photographs.
March 9, 2024
Inspected the vehicle damage. The damage pattern lines up with the described impact and the reported speed range,
and no earlier damage to the vehicle is known from prior claims or inspection records.
March 22, 2024
Claimant reported neck pain and stiffness consistent with whiplash. The reported symptoms fit the kind and force of
the crash well.
May 6, 2024
Medical records received from the treating provider. No prior injury to the same body area is recorded in the
claimant's history or in available prior claims data.
May 23, 2024
Treatment has continued somewhat longer than is typical for this injury. Requested updated treatment notes and a
treatment plan to understand the recovery timeline.
June 11, 2024
Claimant was re-contacted for a follow-up interview. The account of events was the same as in every previous
conversation, with no material differences in the timeline or description.
June 14, 2024
File reviewed and all documentation is in order. Recommend moving the injury component to eavluation for
settlement, pending receipt of the updated treatment notes.
</page>

List the facts written on this page. Copy each value exactly as it is written: same spelling,
punctuation and date format. Do not add anything that is not on this page. Use "" for a missing value.

Person "role" must be one of: claimant, attorney, defense_attorney, expert, doctor, officer, adjuster, witness, other.
  claimant = the person who made the claim (also called patient, plaintiff, client, customer,
  or the driver who reported it). attorney = a lawyer for the claimant or plaintiff.
  defense_attorney = a lawyer for the insurance company or defendant.
Organization "type" must be one of: repair_shop, clinic, law_firm, court, insurer, police, other.
"policy_numbers" = only values labeled as a policy number. A claim number is not a policy number.
"street" and "city" = the person's own home address, only if the page gives it. Never use the
address of a clinic, shop, firm or court for a person.
"loss_dates" = only a date that the page clearly gives as the date of the accident, crash, loss or
injury. Do not list the date of a note, letter, report, visit, statement, filing or signature.
"words_before" = the words written on the page directly before that date, copied exactly, that say
it is the loss date. Examples: "Date of loss:", "Crash date:", "Date of injury:", "the collision on".
